image_description: A black heavy-duty ring binder standing upright, angled to show the spine and front cover. The spine is orange with 'Heavy Duty' text and branding. The front cover has a large clear plastic pocket containing a promotional insert showing the ring mechanism and product details. The binder appears to be a standard 3-ring binder with a D-ring mechanism visible through the pocket insert.
